1: Jab aasman phat jayega, un farishton ke utarne ki wajah se jo us se utrenge,
2: aur woh apne Rubb ka hukm farmanbardari se sunega, jaisa us ka haqq hai.
3: Jab zameen ko Allah us tarah phailayega jis tarah chamra kheencha jata hai,
4: aur woh apne andar ke khazane aur murde bahar daal degi aur un se khaali ho jayegi,
5: aur woh apne Rubb ka hukm farmanbardari se sunegi, jaisa us ka haqq hai.
6: Aey insan, tu ya bhalai kar raha hai ya buraai, aur qayamat ke din tu us se mulaqat karega, taake Allah tujhe us ka badla de.
7: Allah ne insan ke amal ka mukhtasar zikr kiya, phir qayamat ke din amal karne walon ka haal tafseel se bayan kiya aur farmaya: pas jis ko us ka aamaal-naama us ke seedhe haath mein diya jayega,
8: us ka hisaab Allah aasan le lega aur us ke aamaal us ke saamne pesh honge, magar us ki giraft na hogi,
9: aur woh khush-khushi apne ghar walon ki taraf laut jayega.
10: Aur jis ko us ka aamaal-naama us ki peeth ke peechhe se baaein haath mein diya jayega,
11: woh apne liye halakat ko pukarega,
12: aur woh jahannum ki aag mein daakhil hoga taake us ki garmi bardasht kare.
13: Duniya mein woh apne ghar walon ke darmiyan apne kufr aur gunahon par khush hota tha.
14: Us ne gumaan kiya tha ke marne ke baad woh dobara zinda na hoga.
15: Beshak Allah usey usi tarah dobara zinda karega jis tarah us ne usey pehli baar paida kiya tha. Us ka Rubb us ke haal ko dekh raha tha; us mein se kuch us se chhupa na tha, aur woh usey us ke aamaal ka badla dega.
16: Allah ne us surkhi ki qasam khai jo sooraj doobne ke baad ufuq par hoti hai,
17: aur raat ki qasam khai aur us cheez ki jo us mein simat aati hai,
18: aur chaand ki jab woh poora ho kar chaudhween ka chaand ban jata hai.
19: Aey insan, tu ek haalat ke baad doosri haalat par charhta jayega: pehle ek boond, phir jama hua khoon, phir gosht ka tukra, phir zindagi, phir maut, aur phir dobara zinda hona.
20: In kafiron ko kya hua, jo Allah par aur aakhirat ke din par iman nahin rakhte,
21: aur jab un ke saamne Quran parha jata hai to apne Rubb ko sajda nahin karte?
22: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jin logon ne kufr kiya, woh us cheez ko jhutlate hain jo un ke Rasool un ke paas laaye.
23: Allah khoob jaanta hai jo un ke dilon mein hai. Un ke aamaal mein se kuch us se chhupa nahin.
24: Aey Rasool ﷺ, unhein us dard-nak azaab ki khabar de dijiye jo un ka muntazir hai.
25: Siwaye un logon ke jo Allah par iman rakhte hain aur neik aamaal karte hain; un ke liye aisa ajr hai jo kabhi khatam na hoga, yani jannat.
